messages:
erin: Heads-up — short maintenance window tonight for cross-service change (API / runtime / router / console). Window 01:00-01:20 PT. Target pins: api=2.2.0, runtime=3.1.0-canary, router=1.6.0. Canary traffic start=3% then ramp. Release notes: https://gist.github.com/redwood/release-1745 :spiral_note_pad:
jamal: Quick alignment Q: we need a graceful session-affinity drain on router before shifting any traffic to avoid half-handshakes. Planned drain command/time?
erin: plan: 1) router pin, 2) router drain 90s to clear sticky sessions, 3) runtime pin, 4) api pin, 5) start 3% canary. Unpin reverse with 45s gaps. I'll add to ops checklist.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] preflight queued at 1745000020 for services: router, runtime, api, console. Canary=3%. Preflight checks: schema-compat, config-lock, canary-capacity, smoke-suite. Links: https://deploy/redwood/1745000001
leo: Router drain command (example):
```
kc exec -n router router-ops-01 -- /bin/sh -c "curl -X POST http://localhost:9000/drain?grace=90"
```
Add header scrub: `x-rw-session` -> rewrite to new cookie after drain.
tess: Observability note — include trace header `x-rw-trace` and tag canary=true so dashboards filter cleanly. Also add a quick OTLP snapshot at T+5 and T+12.
sre-oncall: Rollback heuristics suggested: sustained 5xx > 0.75% for 4m OR p99 latency > 3x baseline for 2m -> auto-hold and alert. Also GPU OOM rate > 3 events/min -> immediate rollback. Add queue depth spike > 400 -> pause.
jamal: For runtime canary, enable `--graceful-eviction=true` and KV prefill on canary nodes. Warmup snippet:
```
kubectl -n runtime run warmup --image=tools:latest --restart=Never -- /bin/sh -c "python prefill.py --model=micro --iters=500"
```
Mark warmup logs in deploy page.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] preflight status: schema-compat=PASS, config-lock=PASS, canary-capacity=OK, warmup=OK, smoke-suite=RUNNING.

jamal: Small operational rule: run router pin with `--max-in-flight=1` to move single shard at a time. Keeps sticky session transitions minimal.
erin: A few manual controls: we will hold at 3% for 12m (smoke + perf). If all green -> promote to 30% then 100% over 20m. If any auto-check trips, we keep pins and run fast rollback to previous pinned artifacts.
leo: Rollback CLI for ops: `deployctl rollback --to=runtime@3.0.2 --services=runtime,api,router --reason="canary-failure"` (ops+oncall auth).
sre-oncall: Add escalation tree in commit: eng-oncall -> eng-release -> platform lead. If hold > 18m, call a manual incident and freeze traffic.
tess: Smoke evals to run: `smoke/basic`, `smoke/affinity-drift`, `smoke/kv-hitrate`. Fail criteria: affinity-drift > 5% OR kv-hitrate drop > 8% -> rollback.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] rollout started at 1745000080. Canary nodes: runtime-canary-0[1-3], router-shard-canary-02. Notifying #eng-oncall and #deploy-notify.
leo: Warmup finished, kv hitrate +4%. router drain observed 88s. No sticky sessions in logs.
jamal: Running OTLP snapshot now, trace id prefix=canary-1745.
sre-oncall: Observability baseline checks passing. p99 within expected, 5xx=0.12%. Holding for smoke window.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] smoke-suite results at 1745000150: smoke/basic=PASS, smoke/affinity-drift=PASS, smoke/kv-hitrate=PASS. Holding remaining 2m before ramp.
erin: If green, proceed to 30%. Keep `--graceful-eviction` on until 100% completes. Note: console UI flags deploy is purely client toggle; unpin after backend stable.
tess: Reminder: update runtime feature flags in config-hosts before 50% to avoid mismatched responses.
leo: Final note: when unpinning, remove router pin first (after stagger) then api then runtime. Unpin gaps 45s to avoid leftover headers.
erin: Kicking to 30% now. Standby for rollback command. Thanks team. :rocket:
